report.summary: Both failures are the same test bug: the page object BooksPage.add clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the books template renders the button as data-testid="add-book", so the click times out after 5s before the test reaches its assertions. Fix tests/support/pages.py:44 to use "add-book" first, then rerun both tests; the app itself looks correct.

causes.title: Page object uses a test id that does not exist in the books template
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() looks for the submit button with data-testid "add-books", but app/templates/books.html defines it as "add-book". Playwright waits for the locator, finds nothing, and raises a TimeoutError on click. Both tests that call books.add() fail at this line before any product behavior is exercised. The other books tests (API-created row, delete) do not call add() and pass, which fits this being a locator mismatch rather than an app outage.
evidence: Traceback: tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:13 and :42 both go through BooksPage.add in tests\support\pages.py:44
causes.suggested_fix: Change tests/support/pages.py line 44 to self.page.get_by_test_id("add-book").click(). Better, check the other ids in BooksPage against books.html while there. Then rerun tests/ui/test_books_ui.py. If the button id was renamed on purpose, update the template-side expectation instead, but the template is the current source of truth here.
